mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_dict_type ORDER BY id LIMIT 1001
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dict_type(code, name, enabled) VALUES (#{entity.code}, #{entity.name}, #{entity.enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dict_type SET code = #{entity.code}, name = #{entity.name}, enabled = #{entity.enabled}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{entity.id} AND version = #{entity.version}
